description: Build a dated countdown plan for a party, with task lists at 6 weeks, 4, 3, 2 and 1 week, 3 days, the day before and the day itself. Use when the date is set and the host needs to know what to do when. Do NOT use for spending (use party_budget) or a categorized supplies list (use party_checklist).

event_type.description: Optional event label added to the T-21 tasks, e.g. 'birthday', 'bbq' or 'kids party'

guests.description: Optional guest count 1-1000; adds a cake-sizing task at T-14

name: party_timeline

milestones.description: Countdown milestones from T-42 days to the day itself

date.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD to finish these tasks by

note.description: How to read the milestone dates

title: Party timeline
